exposure: Increased baseline left ventricular end-diastolic dimension
cohort: The study population comprised 340 patients (mean age, 33 years) diagnosed with PPCM between January 2000 and September 2022 in 26 tertiary hospitals in South Korea.
finding: While the incidence of PPCM has increased over the past 20 years, the prognosis has not improved significantly, and high body mass index, gestational diabetes, and increased baseline left ventricular end-diastolic dimension are significant risk factors for poor prognosis.
